transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started. As we discussed, we're looking at a six-week pilot to reduce classroom disruptions from student cell-phone use, covering grades 9 and 10, with phones placed in open classroom bins and a tentative launch date of September 2, 2026. Before I approve any student-facing procedures, I need each of you to report any operational information you have. Let's start with our teacher representative -- what can you tell us?

transcript.text: I want to share some operational findings from my own classroom. I ran a trial with all of my 9th-grade sections and recorded 23 phone-related interruptions in just two weeks. I also tested numbered locking pouches, and they noticeably reduced interruptions. Based on that, I recommended a grade-9-only pilot using one pouch per student in my team notes — but I should mention those notes haven't been added to the draft proposal yet.
